inputs.T: Running a large language model in production is largely a balancing act between latency and throughput. Latency is the time a single user waits for a response, while throughput measures how many requests the system handles per second. To serve more users on the same GPU, engineers often batch several requests together, but aggressive batching can increase the latency that any individual user experiences. Quantization lowers the numerical precision of the model's weights to reduce memory usage and speed up inference, usually at a small cost to output quality.
